name: Government student and new-grad job programs (FSWEP, Ontario SEO, Ontario Internship Program)
summary: Federal and Ontario public-service hiring streams reserved for students (FSWEP, Ontario Summer Employment Opportunities) and recent graduates (Ontario Internship Program).
whatYouDo: You submit a profile or applications to a government student inventory or job board; departments and ministries hire students for temporary jobs (often summer, sometimes part-time during the school year) or recent grads for internships. Work ranges from office and program support to field jobs such as natural-resources roles.
appeal: FSWEP is the federal government's largest student hiring program, open to full-time high-school, college and university students returning to studies
FSWEP part-time roles possible during the school year; full-time in breaks
Ontario SEO hires up to about 4,000 students for 7-18 week full-time summer jobs; 2027 postings expected in fall/winter
Ontario Internship Program is for recent college/university grads (within 2 years; 5 years for bilingual, Indigenous or disabled candidates); recruitment begins in December
Government work experience for your resume
watchOuts: Student status required (FSWEP: full-time and returning next term)
Being in the FSWEP inventory does not guarantee a referral; departments search the pool
Ontario SEO 2026 ads are closed and OIP applications are currently closed (ontario.ca)
SEO requires living in Ontario during the job, age 15+ (some roles 18+), legal right to work and a SIN
International-student eligibility for FSWEP only claimed by a third-party guide; unverified
A 2019-20 PSC audit found departments saw FSWEP rules as inflexible and some referrals were bypassed

credentials: current student status (FSWEP, SEO) or recent degree/diploma (OIP)

compensation.notes: Pay set per posting. An older Ontario page listed SEO pay around $15.00-$15.85/hr; outdated.

applicationSteps: FSWEP: submit a student profile through the federal student inventory; departments search it and contact candidates
Ontario SEO: from fall/winter, apply to each posting on the OPS Summer Employment Opportunities board (resume and cover letter in one document, up to 5 pages)
OIP: watch ontario.ca for the next intake; recruitment begins in December
fitsIf: You are a full-time student or recent Ontario grad who wants paid government work experience.
notFitIf: You are not a student or recent grad, or you need work immediately this autumn.

sources.title: Horizontal Audit of Student Hiring under the Federal Student Work Experience Program
sources.notes: 2019-20 audit: FSWEP was 62% of student hires; departments found rules inflexible; weak learning-plan compliance; some referrals possibly bypassed.
